summary: Macro backdrop for ags: headwind (score -7 across rates, dollar, Brazil real, risk, energy, China, breadth). rates 0; dollar −; brl −; mxn −; risk −; energy −; china −; breadth −. Strongest ag/soft over the month: Rough rice +6.0%; weakest: Lean hogs -21.5%. Key releases ahead: US Core PCE Price Index m/m (11-25 8:30 AM ET); US Prelim GDP q/q (11-25 8:30 AM ET).

sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 4.91% (-9 bp in a month), 2-year 4.63% (-6 bp); 2s10s curve +28 bp (-3 bp in a month). Yields are little changed on the month. T-bill yield 4.15% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 103.94 (+1.9% in a month, +5.8% YTD). A stronger dollar makes US grain, oilseeds, cotton and meat dearer abroad. USD/BRL 5.861 (+18.2% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.660 (-0.3%); USD/MXN 19.74 (+5.4%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -8.8% in a month (+2.3% YTD); VIX 33.5. Risk-off: funds tend to cut commodity length along with equities.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 83.33 $/bbl (-16.2% in a month), Brent 89.87, ULSD 3.685 $/gal (-20.5%), natural gas 3.65 (+3.9%). Lower crude weighs on soybean oil and corn through biofuel margins and on cotton via cheaper polyester.

sections.title: China & industrial demand
sections.text: Copper -19.7% in a month, Shanghai Composite -6.0%, Hang Seng -5.4%, yuan +0.3% vs USD. Soft China/industrial signals point to weaker import demand.

sections.title: Commodity breadth
sections.text: 9 of 33 commodities trade above their 50-day average (27%); S&P GSCI -14.5% in a month; gold -14.6%.

caveat: Directional channels from macro to ag prices are standard relationships, not signals tested on this desk; use as context.

events_ahead.title: Core PCE Price Index m/m
